input.subject: The Sunday Sharpener - 5 ideas to start your week
input.bodyText:
Good morning,

Here are 5 things worth your attention this week:

1. The two-minute rule for beating procrastination - if it takes less than two minutes, do it now.
2. Why 'deep work' blocks beat multitasking every time.
3. A recipe: 15-minute lemon garlic shrimp.
4. The book everyone's quietly re-reading this summer.
5. One question to ask yourself every Friday.

Have a great week,
The Sunday Sharpener
